events.info: HARLEM GLOBETROTTERS: RIVALRY TOUR Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington Generals and new lineup of rivals step onto the court - hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching, you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron.. Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric, and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now.
events.pleaseNote: A warning to any fans with light sensitivity that strobing effects will be used during light shows within the Harlem Globetrotters game. By purchasing this ticket, you give permission to use your likeness

venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Wright State University's Nutter Center is handicapped accessible. Tickets are available at all Ticketmaster outlets, charge-by-phone, at the box office, and Ticketmaster online. generalInfo.generalRule: Typically video and/or recording devices are not permitted in the facility. Camera policies differ from show to show. Please check the event page on the venue website www.nuttercenter.com for additional information.
generalInfo.childRule: Children under 2 are free if they sit on an adult’s lap (unless otherwise stated). Certain children/family shows require kids 1 and over to purchase a ticket. For WSU Raiders Basketball games, children under 3 are free if they sit on an adult's lap.

accessibility.info:
Accessible seating is available for wheelchairs and patrons with limited mobility and companions. There is a 4 ticket limit for all accessible seating, unless otherwise posted.

Wheelchair patrons should purchase 1 wheelchair seat as their seat and up to 3 companion seats. Wheelchair companions should also purchase wheelchair seats as their seat. Limited mobility patrons should purchase 1 limited mobility seat as their seat and up to 3 companion seats. Limited mobility companions should also purchase limited mobility seats as their seat.  

Sight/Hearing impaired patrons should contact the box office directly at (937) 229-4433 during regular business hours to purchase tickets and inquire about additional accomodations.

Wheelchair accessible seats are located in Sections 201, 203-204, 210, 212-213, 215-216, 222 and 224.  Mobility impaired seats are in Row P of Sections 211 and 214.  More information is available at the Customer Service window in the Southwest corner of the Arena.
